readings.title: Land Remaining to be Possessed
readings.subtitle: The Command to Divide the Inheritance
readings.text:
[Joshua 13:1] And Yehoshua was old, advanced in years. And <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to him, <dq>You are old, advanced in years, and still much of the land remains to be possessed.</dq>
[13:2] <dq>This is the land that remains: all the districts of the Philistines and all the Geshurites,</dq>
[13:3] <dq>from Shiḥor which is in front of Mitsrayim, and up to the border of Eqron northward, are considered as Kena‛anite – the five princes of the Philistines, the Azzathites, and the Ashdoḏites, the Eshqelonites, the Gittites, and the Eqronites; also the Avvites</dq>
[13:4] <dq>on the south; all the land of the Kena‛anites, and Me‛arah that belongs to the Tsiḏonians as far as Aphěq, to the border of the Amorites;</dq>
[13:5] <dq>and the land of the Geḇalites, and all Leḇanon, toward the sunrise, from Ba‛al Gaḏ below Mount Ḥermon as far as the entrance to Ḥamath;</dq>
[13:6] <dq>all the inhabitants of the mountains from Leḇanon as far as Misrephoth Mayim, and all the Tsiḏonians. <dn>I</dn> <dn>Myself</dn> drive them out from before the children of Yisra’ěl. Only, divide it by lot to Yisra’ěl as an inheritance, as <dn>I</dn> have commanded you.</dq>
[13:7] <dq>And now, divide <dn>את</dn> this land as an inheritance to the nine tribes and half the tribe of Menashsheh.</dq>

readings.title: The Inheritance Beyond the Jordan
readings.subtitle: Reuben, Gad, and Half-Manasseh

readings.title: The Territory of Reuben
readings.subtitle: Cities of the Plain and the Defeat of Balaam
readings.text:
[Joshua 13:15] And Mosheh gave to the tribe of the children of Re’uḇěn, for their clans:
[13:16] and their border was from Aro‛ěr, which is on the bank of the wadi Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the wadi, and all the plain by Měyḏeḇa,
[13:17] Ḥeshbon and all its cities that are in the plain: Diḇon, and Bamoth Ba‛al, and Běyth Ba‛al Me‛on,
[13:18] and Yahtsah, and Qeḏěmoth, and Měpha‛ath,
[13:19] and Qiryathayim, and Siḇmah, and Tsereth Shaḥar on the mountain of the valley,
[13:20] and Běyth Pe‛or, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Běyth Yeshimoth;
[13:21] and all the cities of the plain, and all the reign of Siḥon sovereign of the Amorites, who reigned in Ḥeshbon, whom Mosheh had stricken with <dn>את</dn> the princes of Miḏyan: <dn>את</dn> Evi, and <dn>את</dn> Reqem, and <dn>את</dn> Tsur, and <dn>את</dn> Ḥur, and <dn>את</dn> Reḇa, princes of Siḥon dwelling in the land.
[13:22] And the sons of Yisra’ěl killed with the sword <dn>את</dn> Bil‛am son of Be‛or, the diviner, among those who were killed by them.
[13:23] And the border of the children of Re’uḇěn was the bank of the Yarděn. This was the inheritance of the children of Re’uḇěn for their clans, the cities and their villages.

readings.title: The Territories of Gad and Half-Manasseh
readings.subtitle: The Inheritance of the Levites
readings.text:
[Joshua 13:24] And Mosheh gave to the tribe of Gaḏ, to the children of Gaḏ for their clans:
[13:25] and their border was Ya‛zěr, and all the cities of Gil‛aḏ, and half the land of the children of Ammon as far as Aro‛ěr, which is before Rabbah,
[13:26] and from Ḥeshbon to Ramath Mitspeh and Betonim, and from Maḥanayim to the border of Deḇir,
[13:27] and in the valley Běyth Haram, and Běyth Nimrah, and Sukkoth, and Tsaphon, the rest of the reign of Siḥon sovereign of Ḥeshbon, the Yarděn being its border, as far as the edge of the Sea of Kinnereth, beyond the Yarděn eastward.
[13:28] This is the inheritance of the children of Gaḏ for their clans, the cities and their villages.
[13:29] And Mosheh gave to half the tribe of Menashsheh, and it was for half the tribe of the children of Menashsheh for their clans:
[13:30] and their border was from Maḥanayim, all Bashan, all the reign of Oḡ sovereign of Bashan, and all the small towns of Ya’ir which are in Bashan, sixty cities;
[13:31] and the half of Gil‛aḏ, and Ashtaroth and Eḏre‛i, cities of the reign of Oḡ in Bashan, were for the children of Maḵir son of Menashsheh, to the half of the children of Maḵir for their clans.
[13:32] These Mosheh gave as an inheritance in the desert plains of Mo’aḇ beyond the Yarděn, by Yeriḥo eastward.
[13:33] But to the tribe of Lěvi Mosheh gave no inheritance. <dn>YeHoVaH</dn>, <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl, <dn>He</dn> was their inheritance, as <dn>He</dn> had said to them.

readings.title: The Inheritance in Canaan
readings.subtitle: The Distribution by Lot
readings.text:
[Joshua 14:1] Now these the children of Yisra’ěl inherited in the land of Kena‛an, which El‛azar the priest, and Yehoshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Yisra’ěl caused them to inherit.
[14:2] Their inheritance was by lot, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded by the hand of Mosheh, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
[14:3] For Mosheh had given the inheritance of the two tribes and the half-tribe beyond the Yarděn, but to the Lěvites he gave no inheritance in their midst.
[14:4] For the children of Yosěph had become two tribes: Menashsheh and Ephrayim. And they gave no part to the Lěvites in the land, except cities to dwell in, with their open land for their livestock and their possessions.
[14:5] As <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> had commanded <dn>את</dn> Mosheh, so the children of Yisra’ěl did, and they divided <dn>את</dn> the land.

readings.title: Caleb's Request and Inheritance
readings.subtitle: The Mountain of Hebron Given to Caleb
readings.text:
[Joshua 14:6] And the children of Yehuḏah came to Yehoshua in Gilgal, and Kalěḇ son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite said to him, “You know <dn>את</dn> the word which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said to Mosheh the man of <dn>Elohim</dn> concerning you and me in Qaḏěsh Barněa.
[14:7] “I was forty years old when Mosheh the servant of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> sent <dn>את</dn> me from Qaḏěsh Barněa to spy out <dn>את</dn> the land, and I brought back word to him as it was in my heart.
[14:8] “But my brothers who went up with me made <dn>את</dn> the heart of the people melt, but I followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> completely.
[14:9] “So Mosheh swore on that day, saying, ‘The land on which your foot has trodden is your inheritance and your children’s forever, because you have followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> my <dn>Elohim</dn> completely.’
[14:10] “And now, see, <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> has kept <dn>את</dn> me alive, as <dn>He</dn> said, these forty-five years since <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke <dn>את</dn> this word to Mosheh while Yisra’ěl walked in the wilderness. And now, see, I am eighty-five years old today.
[14:11] “Yet I am still as strong today as I was on the day that Mosheh sent <dn>את</dn> me. As my strength was then, so my strength is now, for battle, and for going out and for coming in.
[14:12] “And now, give me <dn>את</dn> this mountain of which <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> spoke in that day, for you heard in that day how the Anaqim were there, and that the cities were great and walled. If <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> is with <dn>את</dn> me, then I shall dispossess them, as <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> said.”
[14:13] Yehoshua then blessed him, and gave <dn>את</dn> Ḥeḇron to Kalěḇ son of Yephunneh as an inheritance.
[14:14] So Ḥeḇron became the inheritance of Kalěḇ son of Yephunneh the Qenizzite to this day, because he followed <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> <dn>Elohim</dn> of Yisra’ěl completely.
[14:15] Now the name of Ḥeḇron was formerly Qiryath Arba (Arba was the greatest man among the Anaqim). And the land had rest from fighting.

readings.title: The Borders of Judah
readings.subtitle: The Southern, Eastern, Northern, and Western Boundaries
readings.text:
[Joshua 15:1] And the lot of the tribe of the children of Yehuḏah for their clans was to the border of Eḏom, the Wilderness of Tsin southward in the extreme south.
[15:2] And their southern border began at the edge of the Salt Sea, from the bay that faces southward.
[15:3] And it went out to the southern side of the Ascent of Aqrabbim, passed over to Tsin, and went up on the south side of Qaḏěsh Barněa, and passed over to Ḥetsron, went up to Aḏar, and went around to Qarqa,
[15:4] and passed over to Atsmon, and went out to the wadi of Mitsrayim, and the border ended at the sea. This is your southern border.
[15:5] And the east border was the Salt Sea as far as the end of the Yarděn. And the border on the northern quarter began at the bay of the sea at the end of the Yarděn.
[15:6] And the border went up to Běyth Ḥoḡlah and passed over north of Běyth Araḇah. And the border went up to the stone of Bohan son of Re’uḇěn.
[15:7] And the border went up toward Deḇir from the Valley of Aḵor, and it turned northward toward Gilgal, which is before the Ascent of Aḏummim, which is south of the wadi. And the border passed over to the waters of Ěn Shemesh and ended at Ěn Roḡěl.
[15:8] And the border went up by the Valley of the Son of Hinnom to the southern slope of the Yeḇusite city, that is Yerushalayim. And the border went up to the top of the mountain that lies before the Valley of Hinnom westward, which is at the end of the Valley of Repha’im northward.
[15:9] And the border went around from the top of the hill to the fountain of the water of Nephtovaḥ, and went up to the cities of Mount Ephron. And the border went around to Ba‛alah, that is Qiryath Ye‛arim.
[15:10] And the border turned around from Ba‛alah westward to Mount Sě‛ir, and passed over to the side of Mount Ye‛arim on the north, that is Kesalon, and went down to Běyth Shemesh, and passed over to Timnah.
[15:11] And the border went out to the side of Eqron northward. And the border went around to Shikkeron, and passed over to Mount Ba‛alah, and went out to Yaḇne’ěl. And the border ended at the sea.
[15:12] And the west border was the coastline of the Great Sea. This is the boundary of the children of Yehuḏah all around for their clans.

readings.title: Caleb Occupies Hebron and Debir
readings.subtitle: The Request of Achsah
readings.text:
[Joshua 15:13] And to Kalěḇ son of Yephunneh he gave a portion in the midst of the children of Yehuḏah, according to the mouth of <dn>YeHoVaH</dn> to Yehoshua: <dn>את</dn> Qiryath Arba, that is Ḥeḇron – Arba was the father of Anaq.
[15:14] And Kalěḇ drove out <dn>את</dn> the three sons of Anaq from there: <dn>את</dn> Shěshai, and <dn>את</dn> Aḥiman, and <dn>את</dn> Talmai, the children of Anaq.
[15:15] And he went up from there to the inhabitants of Deḇir, and the name of Deḇir formerly was Qiryath Sěpher.
[15:16] And Kalěḇ said, “He who strikes <dn>את</dn> Qiryath Sěpher and shall capture it, to him I shall give <dn>את</dn> Aḵsah my daughter as wife.”
[15:17] And Othni’ěl son of Qenaz, the brother of Kalěḇ, did capture it, so he gave him <dn>את</dn> Aḵsah his daughter as wife.
[15:18] And it came to be, when she came to him, that she persuaded him to ask her father for a field. And when she got off from the donkey, Kalěḇ said to her, “What is the matter?”
[15:19] And she said, “Give me a blessing. Since you have given me land in the South, give me also fountains of water.” And he gave her <dn>את</dn> the upper fountains and <dn>את</dn> the lower fountains.
